mod.name: NoFertilizer
mod.author: kjscott27
kJs-
mod.description:
~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ MOD PREFIX: 072795/ DESCRIPTION - Allows crops to grow without fertilizer at 50% growth rate. You can access the toggle when selecting a bed that a plant is currently growing in (i.e. where you would see growth rate).
If fertilizer is available it will still be consumed to return the plant growth back to 100%. Additionally, when the toggle is on it will hide any in game notifications for missing Fertilizer during the growth of your plants.
